name: In Defense of Frostwolf
label: Quest
description: In Defense of Frostwolf: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The drums of war sound off in a distant land, adventurer. The favored clan of your Warchief is under attack from the nefarious Stormpike Guard of Ironforge.
By the looks of you, I can discern that you are indeed battle hardy and prepared to take on the cause of the Frostwolf.
It is you who must now take the next step in your evolution.
North of Tarren Mill, in Alterac, you will find the entrance to Alterac Valley. It is there that you will find Warmaster Laggrond. Hurry adventurer, for the battle is upon us!

clips.title: Completion
paras: To become a soldier of Frostwolf, one must first be tested...
